source_name: HE32 annual return + audited financial statements (DRCIP)
organization: Department of Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCIP)
license: Public (filed in the register); detailed search EUR 10 per company
record_shape: scanned_pdf_documents (HE32 annual return + audited financial statements) per company per year

fields.meaning: DRCIP registration number identifying the filing company (planning-only — join key).
fields.limitations: Planning-only: figures are inside paid scanned PDFs; no example values copied.

fields.meaning: Shareholders listed on the HE32 annual return (the open register does NOT carry shareholders; they appear here).
fields.limitations: Planning-only, paid, inside scanned PDF; personal data (GDPR). Snapshot, not a continuous BO feed.
fields.analysis_notes: Only open-data-adjacent route to shareholders short of the restricted UBO register; requires OCR/parsing.

fields.meaning: Directors and secretary as recorded on the annual return.
fields.limitations: Planning-only, paid PDF; overlaps officers in the open CSV.

fields.analysis_notes: Parse from the annual return document.

fields.meaning: Accounting reference date / financial year the statements cover.
fields.limitations: Planning-only; one document set per year.
fields.analysis_notes: Part of the financials[] array key.

fields.meaning: Statement of financial position: assets, equity, liabilities.
fields.limitations: Planning-only, paid; inside a scanned PDF — requires OCR. No structured XBRL/CSV of figures. Currency EUR.
fields.analysis_notes: Structured figures need OCR or a commercial provider.

fields.meaning: Profit-and-loss: revenue, expenses, profit/loss for the period.
fields.limitations: Planning-only, paid, scanned PDF — OCR required. Currency EUR.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to financials[].revenue / profit_loss once parsed.

fields.meaning: Notes to the financial statements (accounting policies, breakdowns).

fields.limitations: Planning-only; Cyprus statements are audited — an auditor report is expected.
